primary_work.title: Towards the Causal Complete Cause of Multi-Modal Representation Learning

decision: NARROWED BEYOND CAUSALLY COMPLETE MULTI-MODAL PREDICTION — NOT ADOPTED
prior_art_boundary: causally sufficient and necessary multi-modal prediction representations and C3 risk are existing work under the paper assumptions
using language as an observed modality in a supervised causal-completeness objective does not discover raw-language equivalence
task-critical or ablation-critical features do not uniquely identify a latent intervention-target partition or denotation
task success, counterfactual prediction, and representation necessity cannot substitute for direct recovery of utterance and target partitions
counterexample: Two models related by simultaneous invertible recoding of representation coordinates and relabeling of target blocks, raw-utterance classes, modalities, instruments, denotation, encoder, and decoder preserve the full observed prediction law, counterfactual branches, C3 sufficiency and necessity, task metrics, and language-conditioned predictions while assigning different utterance equivalence relations and semantic target correspondences.
official_code_status: paper-specific official code verified at immutable commit; Python 3.9 quick start and training commands exist, but dependency lock, immutable datasets and splits, canonical three-seed manifest, expected checksums, no-pretrained-LM R0 configuration, and resource bundle are not established
